Apple___Apple_scab.description: Apple scab is a common fungal disease that affects leaves and fruit.
treatment: Use locally approved fungicides when needed

Tomato___Early_blight.description: Early blight is a fungal disease of tomato foliage and fruit.
symptoms: Dark concentric rings on older leaves

Tomato___healthy.description: The image is classified as a healthy tomato leaf.
prevention: Continue regular scouting and balanced irrigation.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Late blight is a fast-spreading tomato disease that can damage leaves, stems, and fruit.
treatment: Use locally approved management advice promptly

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.description: Septoria leaf spot is a fungal disease that commonly begins on lower tomato leaves.
symptoms: Small circular spots with pale centers

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.description: Two-spotted spider mites are sap-feeding pests that can weaken tomato leaves.
symptoms: Webbing and bronzed leaves in severe cases
treatment: Use locally approved integrated pest-management measures

Tomato___Target_Spot.description: Target spot is a tomato leaf disease associated with concentric, target-like lesions.
symptoms: Brown circular lesions with concentric rings
